engineering_basis: Fixed from IO-VNBD documentation, official Android sensor semantics, sensor physics, and runtime-visible S1 statistics; never selected by VBOX error.

coordinate_convention.device: IO-VNBD mounted-phone axes; documented +X travel, gravity-derived +Up, +Left = Up cross Forward
coordinate_convention.tilt: derived from measured gravity; exported Euler pitch/roll are diagnostic only

calibration.fallback: latest distinct pre-blackout phone-GNSS course minus simultaneous exported azimuth, propagated to blackout start by azimuth change

heading.basis: Exported gyroscope Y with negative sign matched pre-blackout phone-GNSS course changes (not VBOX); app/export axes are not standard Android axes.

magnetometer.policy: Apply slow exported-azimuth correction only when magnitude, change rate, azimuth rate, and gyro-heading innovation all pass.

bias.policy: Robust median only from causally confirmed pre-blackout stationary samples; otherwise exactly zero with fallback recorded.

motion_state.zupt_policy: Set horizontal velocity to zero and hold position only in LIKELY_STATIONARY; no generic moving-state damping.
